meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写网络小说时自动匹配趁手工具,并记住你的写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在写网络小说,希望工具顺着你的习惯走
copy.tagline_en: Auto-match the right writing tools and remember your habits as you draft web novels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want tools that adapt to your habits

howto.what: 它是网文工具箱的入口：按你的需求转发到具体 skill（如写长篇、拆文、扫榜），也能管理作者习惯、启动本地工作台、检查更新。
howto.when: 当你用 /story、$story 等命令，或说「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」时触发；只说要写小说未指明篇幅时，它会先问长篇还是短篇再路由。

say.note: 启动本地 Dashboard 并回传可点击地址

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯：先写大纲再写正文
say.note: 写入作者记忆并给出回执
先问你写长篇还是短篇，再转发

howto.what_en: Entry point of a web-novel toolbox: it reads your request and routes you to the right skill (long-form writing, story breakdown, ranking scans), and can also manage author habits, open a local dashboard, or check for updates.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story, $story, or phrases like "I want to write a novel", "open the dashboard", "check for updates". If you only say you want to write, it first asks long-form or short.

say_en.note: Starts the local dashboard and returns a clickable URL

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: outline first
say_en.note: Saves it to author memory and returns a receipt

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: Asks long or short form, then routes
